# Wilson Barbershop Co.

> Family-friendly barbershop in South Gosforth, Newcastle upon Tyne, established 2013. Haircuts, skin fades, kids' cuts, beard trims and traditional hot towel shaves. Online booking available.

- Address: Tenerife Buildings, 6 Station Rd, South Gosforth, Newcastle upon Tyne NE3 1QD, UK (5 minute walk from South Gosforth Metro Station)
- Phone: 0191 284 8786
- Email: information@wilsonbarber.co.uk
- Opening hours: Tuesday-Friday 10:00-19:00; Saturday 08:00-16:00; Sunday and Monday closed
- Booking: https://belliata.com/online-booking?vi=67638
- Walk-ins welcome; appointments recommended
- Free parking when your car registration is registered in-store
